attack.name: Gore Charge
attack.telegraph: Lowers its head, paws the earth. The quills lie flat — then rise.

edible.note: Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The quills make excellent awls.

codexStages.unknown: Something heavy moved in the thicket. The birds went quiet first.
codexStages.observed: Feral hog, twisted: fused bristle grown into quills. Charges in straight lines — it cannot turn quickly. Territorial; it warns once.
codexStages.slain: Thornback Boar. Moves: Gore Charge (heavy, telegraphed), Trample (close range, after a missed charge), Retreat (below 25% hp, may return). Flanks are soft — harry it, then strike. Meat: excellent. Do not waste it.

attack.name: Silent Rush
attack.telegraph: No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving.

edible.note: Edible but lean. The old taboo itches; hunger doesn't care.

codexStages.unknown: The woods went silent all at once. Not quiet — silent. Like the world holding its breath.
codexStages.observed: Feral dogs, twisted into silence: no barks, no whines, no growls. They coordinate without sound — watch the lead animal's ears. Pack of 3-5.
codexStages.slain: Hushwolf. Moves: Silent Rush (ambush opener, heavy), Harass (pack members circle, light hits), Withdraw (if the lead falls). They fear fire — they remember being dogs. Wound the lead and the pack breaks.

attack.name: Antler Sweep
attack.telegraph: Stamps once. Lowers the crown. It does not bluff.

edible.note: Venison. The best meat in the woods, and the saddest. Thank it.

codexStages.unknown: A deer. Wrong season for the rut, wrong look in its eye. It saw you first.
codexStages.observed: Whitetail, twisted: antlers that never shed, aggression without season. It is still, underneath, a deer — and it knows the woods better than you.
codexStages.slain: Gallowdeer. Moves: Antler Sweep (telegraphed, heavy), Bolt (flees at 50% hp — let it go or track it), Trample (only if cornered). Skittish at range; exhausts fast. The meat is worth the sorrow.
